items.t: Radiator leaks coolant into the transmission
items.job: Replace radiator and flush transmission fluid
items.note: Price is for catching it early. If coolant has already damaged the transmission, a rebuild or replacement adds several thousand dollars.

items.t: Engine knock from scuffed cylinder 7
items.job: Replace short block (lower engine)
items.note: Covered under Nissan's bulletin while the powertrain warranty applies. Owners outside warranty have been quoted about $9,200 to over $10,000.

items.t: Cracked exhaust manifolds
items.job: Replace one exhaust manifold and gaskets
items.note: Broken studs add time. Replacing both sides roughly doubles the cost; aftermarket headers are another option.

items.t: Catalytic converters break up and clog
items.job: Replace failed catalytic converter
items.note: Fix any misfire or oil burning first or the new converter will fail too.

items.t: No-start and BCI warnings from failing brake light switch
items.job: Replace stop lamp (brake light) switch
items.note: The switch itself is cheap; most of the cost is diagnosis.

items.t: Rear A/C lines leak under the truck
items.job: Replace rear A/C refrigerant line section and recharge
items.note: RepairPal estimates about $1,750–$1,900 for refrigerant line replacement; a leak test comes first.

items.t: Rear self-leveling suspension sags
items.job: Replace rear air springs and/or compressor
items.note: A ride height sensor alone has been quoted around $860 at a dealer. Converting to regular springs and shocks is often cheaper.

items.t: Power liftgate stops working
items.job: Tighten liftgate motor bolt and replace gas struts
items.note: Low end is struts and a bolt; high end includes a liftgate motor.

items.t: Clicking behind dash from blend door actuators
items.job: Replace blend door actuator
items.note: Some actuators are easy to reach; others need part of the dash removed, which drives the labor.

items.t: Overhead console cracks and sags
items.job: Replace overhead console
items.note: A new dealer console runs about $500 or more; used parts are much cheaper.

items.t: Emergency braking warning with Ethernet codes
items.job: Reprogram radar (distance sensor) control unit
items.note: Normally covered under the new-vehicle warranty.
